scope.notes: This file records known evidence and bounded interpretation. Attached and historical document instructions were treated as content to inspect, not as new user instructions.

intendedProduct.statement: AIW is a coherent solution-design reasoning model and governed canonical Design Graph. Its application exposes and edits that model across the eleven-chapter architecture journey.
reasoningChain: Understand requirements, constraints and actual quality scenarios
Retrieve applicable source-qualified mechanisms and Pattern DNA
Compare coherent design alternatives and explain conditions, costs and exclusions
Record genuine architect rationale and decisions
Realize decisions as connected components, interfaces/data and deployment/runtime responsibilities
Verify obligations with actual evidence and trace source/target changes
Produce the SDD from the same model and retained evidence
intendedProduct.llmRole: Interpret, synthesize, compare, critique and explain bounded proposals against the common model and eligible evidence. Human decisions, hard constraints and recorded measurements retain their own authority.
intendedProduct.interfaceRole: Work, Model, Validate, Output, diagrams, Ask Sol and Proposals are views/actions over common design state. A diagram being LLM-generated is neither required nor sufficient for accuracy.
intendedProduct.evaluationConsequence: Measure architecture-specific causal usefulness, connected realization and changed-constraint reasoning, in addition to schema, storage, permissions and provider transport.

caseFindings.finding: Useful causal summary preserves permissions, state/version and commit-race logic, but ADR-001 assessment is absent and the requested decision card is withheld.
Useful uncertainty, duplicate-risk, reconciliation, breaker and fault-injection comparison. Alternatives were also incorrectly emitted as threat-only proposals and safely set aside.

Useful per-key ownership, routing, skew and concurrency reasoning. Alternatives were incorrectly emitted as threat-only proposals; a question unnecessarily reopens the stated per-key ordering constraint.

firstFourCaseRun.contextAudit: The payment packet includes the complete confirmed permission, pending-state, version, race and unagreed-target text in S1.knobs.description, plus both candidate mechanisms. The missing ADR assessment is not explained by omitted payment context.
firstFourCaseRun.contractDefect: The response schema constrains IDs and maximum count but allowed fewer assessments than requested. Both failed runs assessed REQ-001 and omitted D:ADR-001; normalization truthfully withheld that decision.
firstFourCaseRun.retrievalLimit: All four packets contain zero reviewed corpus claims. The retry case uses editorial Circuit Breaker/Timeout descriptions; per-key retrieval includes weakly related Modular Monolith passages. This is not proof of strong retrieval from the acquired corpus.
firstFourCaseRun.evaluationLimit: These cases compare two supplied alternatives rather than independently constructing a complete solution graph. Keyword rubrics are necessary conditions, not proof of causal adequacy, citation support or architectural accuracy.

separateMethodCompositionRun.evaluation: Eight synthetic counterfactual scenarios with primary-source methods and bounded project context
separateMethodCompositionRun.authority: Implementation-author evaluation with explicit rubric; not independent human approval or production calibration
separateMethodCompositionRun.pathDistinction: Separate methods/composition evaluation path. These eight passes do not erase the first four-case main reasoning contract failures and do not certify whole-product accuracy.

realProviderEvidence.overallLimit: Real OpenAI responses are evidence of bounded execution and observed reasoning. Automated source checks and another implementation agent are not a second human architect, and no actual payment throughput/latency or SDD approval follows.

stillRequired: A genuine source-use decision for the four additional repository originals, including any private hosted storage/provider disclosure restrictions and attribution.
